creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From tooling feedback, 2026-10-21, on the Mac. An agent in a pane needed to screenshot another app's window. The person granted Screen Recording to Muster.app, and `screencapture -x` in the pane still failed with "could not create image from display". Pane shells descend from `Muster.app/Contents/Library/MusterSessions.app/Contents/MacOS/muster-daemon`, whose parent is launchd, so macOS judges the request against MusterSessions.app. System Settings does not list that app, and its + file picker cannot select it, since it sits inside Muster.app's bundle. `osascript` fails the same way for Accessibility ("not allowed assistive access").

a_2izzcnNeP (an agent cannot screenshot its own window) met this from the other side, and cites docs/observations/macos-26.4.1.md sections 8 and 9 as saying pane requests are judged against Muster.app's grant. This sighting says otherwise for Screen Recording. Whether a grant to MusterSessions.app applies before the daemon restarts is not established either.

Measure which bundle each permission is charged to on the current macOS, then make the grant reachable: have the daemon request the permission itself, so MusterSessions.app appears in System Settings, or document in `muster docs limits` which bundle to grant and when the grant takes effect.
title: A pane cannot use the Screen Recording or Accessibility grant given to Muster.app
